title: Rows show when due; due badges; compliance is orange and carries no tag
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Read each row's due date wording (the words the asset tab uses).
  2. Check the badges: due soon, due today, overdue (overdue in red).
  3. Find a compliance row and confirm it is orange, never red, even when overdue, and carries no tag.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every row shows when it is due in the words the asset tab uses.
  • Rows carry the asset tab's badges - due soon, due today and overdue, with overdue in red.
  • A compliance row is orange, never red, including when overdue, and carries no tag: the service name and due date identify it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R4: “Every row shows when it is due in the words the asset tab uses, per S11-R9 and S11-R13”
  • S16-R5: “Rows carry the asset tab's badges, due soon, due today and overdue, with overdue in red. A compliance row is orange, never red, including when overdue, per S3-R10”
  • S16-R6: “A compliance row carries no tag. The service name alone identifies it, and the due date already says what it is”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
